designationHistory.indexText: Established Nov. 25, 1975, under the Endangered Species Act with the purchase of 1,749 acres to protect the Mississippi sandhill crane.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Mississippi Sandhill Crane National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1975 under authority of the Endangered Species Act to protect the critically endangered Mississippi sandhill cranes and their unique, and itself endangered, wet pine savanna habitat.
